name: Don't Provoke Him He Controls Destiny
original_name: Don't Provoke Him He Controls Destiny
overview: Juan Yebra, as the Emissary of Hell and possessor of Supreme Divinity who traveled through the three worlds, ended up possessing the body of a despised son-in-law who had died tragically. Only if he managed to have Yulia Leal's family die as dictated by fate, could he return to the Underworld; Otherwise, he would face the total extinction of his being. However, his inner thoughts were exposed, causing events to escape his control.
